articles.title: Sandblasting on Mars
articles.summary: Martian winds can have quite an impact. ESA’s Mars Express has spotted them whipping up sand grains and acting as a cosmic sandblaster, carving out intriguing grooves near Mars’s equator.

articles.title: Algae Swirls Across a South African Reservoir
articles.summary: Vivid green blooms form, drift, and fade in Hartbeespoortdam reservoir over the course of a year.

articles.title: NASA works to extend Swift’s life ahead of reboost mission
articles.summary:
As preparations continue for a mission to raise the orbit of NASA’s Swift astrophysics spacecraft, project officials are also pursuing steps to extend the satellite’s life in case of delays.
The post NASA works to extend Swift’s life ahead of reboost mission appeared first on SpaceNews.

articles.title: Supernova Remnant Video From NASA’s Chandra Is Decades in Making
